title: Mobile Number Revocation List (DoT Digital Intelligence Platform)
purpose: DoT's list of disconnected mobile numbers with the date and reason of disconnection, downloaded from the Digital Intelligence Platform (diu.sancharsaathi.gov.in). DoT publishes no file layout to the public: the columns are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when DIP's differs). A file with no header row is read as the mobile number, the date and the reason.
linked: Matched with every client's mobile and the joint holders' mobiles Ledgerline keeps, on Clients & onboarding → Revoked mobiles.
source: NSE/COMP/74753 (17 Jun 2026): DIP gives the MNRL, "a list of all disconnected mobile numbers, with the reasons and dates of disconnection", near real time, with API integration possible; CDSL/OPS/DP/POLCY/2026/517 (30 Jul 2026): DPs download and verify the MNRL daily on DIP. No file layout is published.
